narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to parts of southeastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon and evening of July 17. Rainfall totals were as high as 1 to 3 inches.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding around the Philadelphia Mills Mall with roads closed and a few vehicles stranded.
A water rescue took place in Bensalem Township.
Minor flooding occurred along the Pennypack Creek in Northeast Philadelphia.
Minor flooding occurred along the Frankford Creek in Philadelphia.
lsr: FLOODING ALONG THE PENNYPACK CREEK BASED ON THE RIVER GAUGE.
FLOODING ALONG THE FRANKFORD CREEK BASED ON THE RIVER GAUGE.
REPORT OF A WATER RESCUE IN BENSALEM. SPOTTER ALSO REPORTED OVER 3 INCHES OF RAIN. TIME ESTIMATED.
